main_text.l: Deut. 14. 3. pro תִּגַּשׁ[?], fut. Kal, 2. s. m. Rad. נָגַשׁ
הָגַז[?] tondebis, avelles, fut. Kal, sing. Rad. גָּזַז, vel גּוֹז.
וַתְּנַח[?] & prodis, fut. Kal, sing. Rad. גּוּחַ.
תַּגִּיד, תַּגִּיד[?] indicabis, תַּגִּידוּ indicabitis, fut. Hiph. s. & 2. pl. m. Rad. נָגַד
תַּגִּין[?] mærore afficietis, Job 19. 2. pro תָּגוּ, fut. Hiph. 2. pl. m. parag. Rad. נָגָה
תָּגִיל, תָּגַל exsultabis, תָּגִלְנָה exsultabitis, &c. fut. Hiph. sing. & plur. Rad. גִּיל.
תָּגִיץ[?] partigerit, וַתָּגֹץ[?] & abjecit, fut. Hiph. sing. Rad. נָגַץ
תִּגִּישׁ[?] offertis, תַּגַּשׁ, vel תִּגּוּשׁ accedas, תִּגְּשׁוּ accedite, תִּגַּשְׁנָה accedent illæ, fut. Hiph. 2. pl. m. & fut. Kal, sing. & plur. Rad. נָגַשׁ
תָּגוֹל[?] retegetur, (pro תִּגָּלֶה,) תָּגֹל retegito, (pro תִּגְלָה,) תִּגְלִי detegito, fut. Niph. & Piel, sing. apoc. & f. Rad. גָּלָה
תְּגַמְּלוֹהִי[?] beneficia ejus, Pf. 116. 12. pl. m. aff. Syr. No. תִּגְמוֹל, Rad. גָּמַל retribuit.
תִּגַּע attinges, תִּגְּשׁ attingetis, fut. Kal, sing. & 2. pl. m. Rad. נָגַע.
וַתָּגָר[?] & peregrinata fuerat, fut. Kal, 3. s. f. R. גּוּר.
וַתַּגֵּר[?] & fecisti diffluere, fut. Hiph. sing. Rad. נָגַר.
תִּגְרְמֵי[?] confringes, fut. Piel, 2. s. f. R. גָּרַם.
תִּגְרְשֶׁן[?] expelles, תִּגְרְשׁוּן expelletis, fut. Piel, sing. & 2. pl. m. Rad. גָּרַשׁ.
מִ תִּגְּרָת[?] à conflictu, constr. sing. fem. præf. No. תִּגְרָה; Rad. נָגַר miscere prælia.

page.notes: Hebrew forms are read from a small, blotted print and are uncertain; each doubtful word is marked [?]. The entry beginning on the left column's last line continues at the top of the right column ("plur. Rad. נָגַשׁ"), and was joined across the column break. The Hebrew catchword ת ד at the foot is taken as a catchword. No printed marginal notes.
